drhp.business: Z-Tech (India) was incorporated in 1994 as a civil construction company that designs, supplies and builds retaining structures. It now has three verticals: sustainable theme parks, industrial wastewater management, and geotechnical and civil engineering. In theme parks it plans, designs, builds, runs and maintains 'Waste to Wonder' parks with artwork made from scrap metal, under EPC, hybrid annuity and self-funded models. These parks are built for municipal corporations and land-owning authorities, which award them through open tenders. It had completed 18 parks by Q2 FY26, mainly in Delhi, Uttar Pradesh and Maharashtra, and has since entered Gujarat. It has also set up a subsidiary in Dubai for its parks business. In wastewater it uses its GEIST and WOOW technologies to deliver zero-liquid-discharge treatment and chemical recovery for industrial clients, under design-build-operate and EPC plus O&M models.
